description: Join specification for multi-source healthcare data integration to Virginia state-month grain

keys.name: state_abbr
keys.derivation: map from raw geography; force 'VA' for VDH; for Synthea use patient location→state; for NHANES mark 'VA' as a PRIOR/WEIGHTED proxy

keys.name: period_id
keys.derivation: truncate encounter/observation/report date to month; if only year present, map to YYYY01 and mark 'low_precision_time' flag

synthetic_patient_key.name: customer_id
synthetic_patient_key.notes: Hash synthetic patient IDs to create anonymized customer_id for analysis; HMAC salt must be stored securely in environment variable

GeoDim.description: Geographic dimension at state level; Virginia-focused with optional FIPS and rural/urban classification

DateDim.description: Temporal dimension at monthly grain; period_id in YYYYMM format with optional start/end bounds

SourceDim.description: Data source and schema tracking dimension

cohort_fact_columns.name: synthea_encounters
cohort_fact_columns.description: Count of synthetic patient encounters in Virginia by month

cohort_fact_columns.name: synthea_dx_rate
cohort_fact_columns.description: Rate of diagnoses per 1,000 synthetic patients

cohort_fact_columns.name: synthea_lab_oob_rate
cohort_fact_columns.description: Percentage of laboratory observations out-of-bounds (abnormal results)

cohort_fact_columns.name: vdh_case_rate
cohort_fact_columns.description: Virginia Department of Health case rate per 100,000 population

cohort_fact_columns.name: nhanes_obesity_rate
cohort_fact_columns.description: NHANES obesity prevalence weighted and projected to Virginia population

cohort_fact_columns.name: nhanes_smoking_rate
cohort_fact_columns.description: NHANES smoking prevalence weighted and projected to Virginia population

cohort_fact_columns.name: nih_cxr_images
cohort_fact_columns.note: only if state available; else set 0 and add 'nih_geo_limited' flag
cohort_fact_columns.description: Count of NIH chest X-ray images; geographic limitation applies

validation_flags.name: low_precision_time
validation_flags.description: Set when period derived only from year (mapped to YYYY01)

validation_flags.name: ambiguous_geo
validation_flags.description: Set when state could not be resolved confidently

validation_flags.name: nih_geo_limited
validation_flags.description: Set when NIH rows lack state mapping; nih_cxr_images forced to 0

nhanes.state_derivation: No geographic data at state level; use survey weights to project national data to VA population (PRIOR/WEIGHTED proxy)
nhanes.period_derivation: Extract from SDDSRVYR (10=2017-2018→201701, 11=2019-2020→201901) with low_precision_time flag

vdh.period_derivation: Extract from 'year' and optional 'month' columns; if month missing, use YYYY01 with low_precision_time flag

synthea.state_derivation: Extract from Patient.address[0].state; filter for state_abbr='VA' or remap if needed
synthea.period_derivation: Extract from Encounter.period.start, Observation.effectiveDateTime, etc.; truncate to YYYYMM

nih.state_derivation: Extract from metadata if available; if missing, set ambiguous_geo and nih_geo_limited flags
nih.period_derivation: Extract from image acquisition date if available; else set low_precision_time flag
nih.notes: NIH chest X-ray dataset typically lacks geographic identifiers; most rows will have nih_geo_limited flag

transformation_pipeline.name: extract_raw
transformation_pipeline.description: Read raw files from all sources (XPT, CSV, JSON, image metadata)

transformation_pipeline.name: derive_keys
transformation_pipeline.description: Create state_abbr, period_id, source_id, schema_variant for each record

transformation_pipeline.name: apply_customer_id_hash
transformation_pipeline.description: For Synthea only: generate customer_id via HMAC_SHA256(patient_id, CAPSTONE_HMAC_SALT)

transformation_pipeline.name: set_validation_flags
transformation_pipeline.description: Mark records with low_precision_time, ambiguous_geo, nih_geo_limited as appropriate

transformation_pipeline.name: filter_to_va
transformation_pipeline.description: Filter to state_abbr='VA' or apply weighted projection for NHANES

transformation_pipeline.name: aggregate_to_grain
transformation_pipeline.description: Group by [state_abbr, period_id] and compute cohort_fact_columns aggregations

transformation_pipeline.name: build_dimensions
transformation_pipeline.description: Construct GeoDim, DateDim, SourceDim lookup tables

transformation_pipeline.name: validate_output
transformation_pipeline.description: Check for required fields, valid ranges, flag completeness

notes: NHANES data is national and does not contain state-level geography. Use survey weights (WTINT2YR, WTMEC2YR) to project prevalence rates to Virginia population.
Synthea synthetic patients default to Massachusetts locations; may need to remap address.state to 'VA' for this analysis.
VDH data is inherently Virginia-specific (133 localities); state_abbr is always 'VA'.
NIH chest X-ray data typically lacks patient geography; most records will have nih_geo_limited flag and nih_cxr_images=0.
CAPSTONE_HMAC_SALT environment variable must be set before running transformation pipeline; never commit salt to repository.
All dates should be validated and standardized to ISO 8601 format before truncation to YYYYMM.
Validation flags are additive; a single record may have multiple flags set.
For NHANES weighted projections, consult CDC analytic guidelines: https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/analyticguidelines.aspx
